study: spec 018: a manoeuvre prior that adapts to the period, and a hedged track

systems.control: ctl-d1-q0.01: the standing control (study L), run unchanged through run4
systems.adaptive, declared: ada-d1-q0.01: a family of 30 priors on the broadened prior (leg mean 600/900/1350/2000/3000 s; leg sd 0.35 or 0.6 of the mean; largest turn 60/100/150 degrees), equal weights; the member with the most evidence in the period (sum over one shared candidate set refitted under each member); declared by the control's rule
systems.adaptive, hedged: ada-h1: the mean track of every member's candidates, weight = member weight x evidence with the quiet probability, temperature 1; stated sd of range = 1.95 x the mixture's sd (the factor from tuning seed 345)
systems.beside: the search told the split's own statistics (true; not a bound); the true-history reference with times held (ref-full; not a bound); members chosen by groups of 5, 20 and all periods (ada-poolN); the per-period choice of output (ada-a0.5, ada-a0.8); the standing control's own hedge (ctl-h1); hedges at temperatures 2 and 3; C'' as a track

statistic: per period, the median error over scored rows (30 s apart, known-history bound on relative range below 0.5), in relative range, course and speed; a ratio a / b is the geometric mean over periods where both medians are finite, with a 95% period bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 17, percentile), reported with its period count, the median per-period ratio and the shares of periods over twice as bad on each side
soundness: validation seed 346, Annex B: history-fixed range efficiency on rows bounded below 0.05 within [0.8, 1.3]; at least 0.9 of true-history fits with a consistent cost; at most 0.25 of references drifting when free. Fails: the study stops before the test seed

conditions.gain: for each of the declared adaptive control and the hedged track, on each of the shifted and shifted 2 splits: control / system in RANGE has an interval wholly above 1.00
conditions.harm: for each, on each of the six splits: control / system in range, course OR speed has an interval wholly below 1.00 (a split with harm cannot count as a gain)
conditions.spread: on each of Annex B and shifted: the share of scored rows whose true range is within two stated sds of the mixture's mean range lies in [0.90, 0.99]
conditions.what_follows: per system: a gain on at least one split and harm on none: proposed to the owner as the standing time-late output (the hedged track only if the spread condition also holds on both splits). A gain with harm anywhere: a trade, reported with both sides; the owner decides. No gain: the standing control stays. The owner decides in every case; the rule fixes what is proposed.

conditions_can_fire (tuning seed 345, no.gain, declared, shifted: 1.10 [0.96, 1.27] on 132 periods; at about 360 scored periods the half-width is about 0.09: fires if the ratio is 1.10 or more, not if it is 1.05
conditions_can_fire (tuning seed 345, no.gain, shifted 2: 1.03 and 1.04, intervals about +-0.12 on 73 periods; unlikely to fire
conditions_can_fire (tuning seed 345, no.harm, declared, Annex B: range 0.90 [0.77, 1.04], course 0.83 [0.68, 1.00] on 89 periods; at about 270 scored periods a ratio of 0.90 in range or 0.85 in course is separated
conditions_can_fire (tuning seed 345, no.harm, hedged, Annex B: course 0.74 [0.60, 0.90]: fires at tuning size already
conditions_can_fire (tuning seed 345, no.harm, held course: declared 0.91 [0.75, 1.04] range, speed 0.88 [0.74, 1.00]; at 200 periods either can fire
conditions_can_fire (tuning seed 345, no.spread: with the factor, 0.97 (Annex B) and 0.94 (shifted) on the rows the factor was fitted to; on a fresh seed either can leave [0.90, 0.99]

forecasts (from tuning seed 345; restate.declared: a trade is the most likely outcome (about one half): a gain on shifted targets and harm on Annex B targets in course. No gain: about one third. A gain without harm: about one in six.
forecasts (from tuning seed 345; restate.hedged: a gain on shifted targets (about two thirds) with harm on Annex B targets in course (about three quarters): a trade.
forecasts (from tuning seed 345; restate.spread: holds on both splits: about one half.
forecasts (from tuning seed 345; restate.groups: choosing a member by groups of periods is level with choosing per period.
forecasts (from tuning seed 345; restate.by kind: the gain sits in the periods where the standing control misses a manoeuvre the bearings show (tuning: 1.53 there, 0.93 elsewhere).

reported_beside: every comparison in range, course and speed with period counts; by kind of period (the control misses a whole true manoeuvre of detectability at least 20 at a 120 s match, or not; terciles of the period's median bound); the adaptive control's share of the true-prior search's gain; manoeuvres missed and false at 60, 120 and 240 s, periods with any false manoeuvre, one-manoeuvre targets called quiet, quiet targets given a manoeuvre; each fixed member; the member chosen and the inferred leg length; coverage by number of true manoeuvres; seconds per period
known_limits: the first design (three rates, a search each) was tried on the tuning seed and gained nothing; this is the second design on the same seed, so the tuning figures flatter it by an unknown amount
the standing control contains Annex B's own prior and the family does not: on Annex B targets the comparison favours the control by construction
the family is built on the broadened prior's ranges for speed changes and turn rates; only leg length, its spread and the largest turn vary
a member's model evidence sums over one shared candidate set found by two searches: a lower limit, and the same histories for every member
the spread factor is one number fitted to pooled Annex B and shifted rows of the tuning seed; the spread is in range only; the hedged mean of mirror-image candidates is a track no target followed
the kind-of-period classing reads the truth and a 120 s tolerance; it is a reading, not something the system can use
prior version 3's recorded faults at the edges of its support apply to every system here
IMM, EKF and one leg are not re-run on these periods (spec 017 scored them on splits of the same kinds)
outlier and correlated-error splits are 100 periods each: only a large effect is separated there
